- No user-facing feature or behavioral changes.

Summary: v1.2.0 enhances LNURL-auth by supporting authentication to LNURL-auth services without a Lightning wallet or node.

- Authenticate to LNURL-auth (LUD-04) services using only a local master secret.
- No wallet, Lightning node, or payment required.
- Optionally inspect decoded challenge and destination before submitting authentication.
- Supports per-domain or single-key authentication; key is derived securely and stored locally.
- Outputs detailed JSON with authentication and response information.
